caption: The drawing shows a brown background with vertical patterns of leafy vines and stylized leaf clusters. The patterns are repeated in parallel arrangements, with two central vertical lines of symmetrical leaf pairs, each leaf consisting of a dark green and burgundy interior. Flanking these central lines, there are two side vines composed of dark green leaves, each vine undulating with a series of overlapping and solitary leaves. At the top edge of the drawing, a decorative frieze-like border is present, featuring a scalloped line with alternating segments of white, gray, and black brush strokes, edged with a red line. The composition is symmetrical, and all elements appear to be hand-rendered. The overall color palette is dominated by earthy browns, greens, reds, and dark neutral tones, with lighter accents in the top border.
title: Stencilled Wall
